title: Optional CI jobs (e2e, Lighthouse, pr-compare fallback, docs-drift, help-autodoc) stop running on pull requests unless the PR carries the full-ci label

source.ref: owner said yes 2026-10-06 ~15:33Z to stopping the optional jobs on PRs, so the PR list only shows real failures

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-06. The merge driver cancels the optional jobs on every PR, and GitHub shows a cancelled job as a red X, so every PR in the list looked failed while the required checks were green. The entry job of each optional workflow (e2e preflight, which pr-compare and lighthouse need; pr-compare-fallback; docs-drift; help-autodoc) now has a job-level `if:` on the `full-ci` label, so they report skipped instead of red. The `on:` blocks are unchanged on purpose: scripts/pixel-paths.mjs, workflow-paths.mjs and vercel-ignore-build.mjs read e2e.yml's pull_request paths. Required checks (checks, lint, test, analyze/CodeQL, db-tests, Vercel per ruleset 17640795) are untouched; pr-compare is not required (pr-compare-fallback.yml header). To run them on a PR, add the full-ci label and push; e2e-manual.yml still runs by hand.

verify.cmd:
node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const want={e2e:"preflight","docs-drift":"drift","help-autodoc":"autodoc","pr-compare-fallback":"fallback"};const bad=[];for(const [f,job] of Object.entries(want)){const p=".github/workflows/"+f+".yml";if(!fs.existsSync(p)){bad.push(p+" is gone");continue}const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const i=s.indexOf("
  "+job+":
");if(i<0){bad.push(p+" has no "+job+" job");continue}const rest=s.slice(i+job.length+5);const end=rest.search(/
    steps:/);const head=end<0?rest:rest.slice(0,end);if(!/
    if: contains\(github\.event\.pull_request\.labels\.\*\.name, .full-ci.\)/.test("
"+head))bad.push(f+"."+job+" still runs on every pull request")}for(const f of ["ci","codeql","db-tests","db-tests-fallback"]){const s=fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/"+f+".yml","utf8");if(/full-ci/.test(s))bad.push(f+".yml is required and must not be label-gated")}if(bad.length){console.error("HYG-163: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}console.log("ok: optional PR jobs run only with the full-ci label; required workflows untouched")'
verify.note: Reads the four optional workflows and fails while any entry job lacks the full-ci label condition before its steps; also fails if a required workflow (ci, codeql, db-tests, db-tests-fallback) gets label-gated. Fails on main, where none are gated.
